name: dsh-skills
description: The SKILLS BROWSER: one button immediately left of the page-zoom control in the conversation header opens a centered modal listing every skill the harness actually loads for this conversation - name, description, where it came from (project / user / custom / bundled / runtime), the provider that owns it, whether the model and the user may invoke it, and the absolute file behind it - and shows that skill's markdown, frontmatter included, with inline editing and a Save that goes back through this plugin's own authenticated route. The catalog is the HOST's: ctx.skills.snapshot() is the same registry the system prompt and the / menu read, so the modal cannot disagree with what the model was given. A file-backed skill is editable here (the client never names a path: it names a skill, and the host writes the file the registry itself resolved, atomically, with an mtime/size guard so a save cannot clobber a concurrent edit); a skill registered at runtime without a file is shown from its loaded content and is honestly read-only. No core patches, no fork, no npm dependencies.
